description:
Phase D of the Results Explorer strategy revision
(plans/purring-jingling-petal-ultraplan).

The canonical CLI chart catalog lives in
`benchbox/core/visualization/chart_types.py` (16 specs) and is
mirrored web-side in `results-explorer/src/lib/chartRegistry.ts`.
Every page currently hardcodes its own tab subset - BenchmarkIndex: 8,
Compare: 6, ResultDetail: 1, Home: 0. The registry is unused at the
call sites it was built for, which is how the drift between CLI and
browser chart sets keeps appearing.

Replace those ad-hoc tab clusters with a single `<ChartPanel>`
component that walks `CHART_REGISTRY`, computes applicable chart IDs
from `entry.requires` vs. the provided `ChartContext`, and dispatches
to the existing chart components. Add a parity test asserting the
web-side registry IDs are a subset of the CLI's
`_CHART_TYPE_DISPATCH` keys so future drift trips CI.

anti_patterns.dont: bundle multiple page migrations into one commit

anti_patterns.why: src/lib/chartRegistry.ts is already the mirror of the CLI

anti_patterns.dont: regress visible tab sets on any page

preserves.behavior: All currently-visible chart tabs in BenchmarkIndex/Compare/ResultDetail continue to render for results that have the required data
CLI _CHART_TYPE_DISPATCH behavior is untouched (web-side change only)
chartRegistry.ts entry.requires gating semantics remain identical - centralization is mechanical

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test
verifications.description: Explorer typecheck + Vitest suites (including new parity test) stay green
Every migrated page renders the expected applicable chart set
verifications.expected: BenchmarkIndex / Compare / PlatformIndex / ResultDetail all show full registry-driven tab sets; unsupported charts disappear (not grayed)

work_units.notes:

and Compare.tsx:371-391 both walk requires[] against per-context
capabilities. Lift into `applicableCharts(context: ChartContext)`
in src/lib/chartRegistry.ts so the three contexts (summary /
compare / detail) share one implementation.

`new Set(web_ids).isSubsetOf(cli_ids)` - web must not ship a
chart the CLI can't produce (logical parity anchor per plan).
